Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.agentexecutor

Class SkillInjector

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.agentexecutor.SkillInjector
public final class SkillInjector extends Object
Tool-call–triggered dynamic skills: activate ids on successful tool results (via execute-tools edge wrap + Command.update()), materialize bodies through ConversationContextPolicy (never written into Graph State).

    • builder

      public static SkillInjector.Builder builder()

    • executeToolsHook

      public EdgeHook.WrapCall<AgentExecutor.State> executeToolsHook()
      Wrap hook for AgentExecutor.Builder.addExecuteToolsHook(org.bsc.langgraph4j.hook.EdgeHook.WrapCall<org.bsc.langgraph4j.agentexecutor.AgentExecutor.State>): after tools run, merge successful tool → skill ids into AgentExecutor.State.ACTIVE_SKILLS.

    • callModelUnloadHook

      public NodeHook.WrapCall<AgentExecutor.State> callModelUnloadHook()
      Wrap hook for AgentExecutor.Builder.addCallModelHook(org.bsc.langgraph4j.hook.NodeHook.WrapCall<org.bsc.langgraph4j.agentexecutor.AgentExecutor.State>): after each callModel node returns its partial state map, filter AgentExecutor.State.ACTIVE_SKILLS through the configured UnloadTarget (no-op when none was set). The filtered list is written back into the same Map channel the node produced, so the next node observes it via AgentExecutor.State.activeSkills().

    • unloadCommand

      public static Command unloadCommand(List<String> current, Command command, UnloadTarget target)
      Apply an UnloadTarget inside a Command channel. Use this overload from edge hooks or from arbitrary nodes that already produce a Command.
      Parameters:
      current - currently activated ids (typically AgentExecutor.State.activeSkills()).
      command - the upstream command — update merged in place via Command.withMergedUpdate(Map).
      target - unload target (never null).
      Returns:
      the original command if nothing changed, otherwise a command with the filtered list merged.

    • unloadMap

      public static Map<String,Object> unloadMap(List<String> current, Map<String,Object> nodeResultMap, UnloadTarget target)
      Apply an UnloadTarget inside a node Map channel. Use this overload from NodeHook.WrapCalls or any node that returns a partial state map.

      The returned map always satisfies: returnedMap.containsKey(ACTIVE_SKILLS) == (something was removed).

    • hasUnloadAfterCallModel

      public boolean hasUnloadAfterCallModel()
      True iff this injector was configured with a post-callModel unload rule via SkillInjector.Builder.unloadAfterCallModel(UnloadTarget).
